originalBaseline.interpretation: All three actual held-File scenarios reached valid import admission, then incorrectly published the older complete backup after newer committed title, raw rotation or trusted sketch intent. UI producer did not rerun this baseline.

implementation.retirement: retireLoad increments private token and updates only load-state busy visibility and Replace saved concept disabled state. It never syncs controls, redraws, cancels an owned gesture, changes editVersion, or changes project/history.
implementation.inputAndActions: Capture-phase input/change incl changed-back values retire pending imports and preserve startupTouched. Shared edit/commit retire as action backstops; existing Cancel/New/Sample/Undo/Redo delegate the same helper. Valid sketch/placement pointer admission retires before focus/capture/transient preview.
implementation.adoption: adoptLoad checks then consumes its matching token before the synchronous shared edit/history publication. Its own later finally is stale and inert; incoming project File.text owner is also checked before parsing/starting image validation.
implementation.lateOutputs: Existing post-async token guards suppress stale photo/backup success and error. finishLoad mutates busy state only for current token and never invokes updateControls. Old success/error/finally cannot clear newer import status or raw fields.
implementation.lifetime: pagehide retires only pending import publication. Late File/bitmap result cannot install after a persisted return. Existing media bitmap cleanup remains untouched.
implementation.compatibility: No model, media, storage, CSS, limits, portable schema, render/export, or startup authority policy changes. Successful imports remain one existing history edit; cancellation/raw retirement creates no history state.
